blocks.text: Six borrowed environmental rhythms arrive in the wrong order and unsettle digestion.
Location: The Folded Garden of Six Traditions
Appearance: Six stationary chambers contract in a deliberately broken sequence instead of orbiting the pet.
Care: Use the digestive treatment listed in Care and sensible portions.
Story connection: A garden steward could ask visitors to restore the order of the six traditions.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed Era Two–Three location derived from the World Bloom traditions and the Folding of Worlds.
